examples.title: wdVasngscrM: One Room Conversion Part 1: Project Introduction — 8 chapters, 168 s

wdVasngscrM.title: One Room Conversion Part 1: Project Introduction
wdVasngscrM.description:
Optimize your investment! Part 1 - Concept, plan, challenges, objective. The demand for a three-bedroom apartment in this part of Seoul is not very high. So the plan is to convert a master bedroom in a three-bedroom apartment into a “one-room” apartment – known as a studio apartment where I come from.
In this video I cover the original 3-BR layout, the basic concept for the conversion, reason for converting it in the first place, and the big expensive challenges you should tackle now to avoid problems and maximize your value in the future.

00:00 Intro
00:35 Concept
00:48 Current 3-BR Layout
01:04 Basic Conversion Plan
01:29 Why do this?
01:42 The Challenges
02:10 Long Term Objective
02:34 About Next Episode

Link to episodes
Episode 1:  https://youtu.be/wdVasngscrM Concept, plan, challenges, objective.
Episode 2: https://youtu.be/XjTEX75Ls0A Preconstruction walkaround planning: Boiler and heating system split, kitchen placement, entry reconfiguration.
Episode 3: A closer look at construction and costs. Coming soon. 
Episode 4: Getting tenants and return on investment. Coming soon.

nTx7Yt7A7eA.title: TAIWANESE FRIED CHICKEN: Mega Crispy Yan Su Ji!
nTx7Yt7A7eA.description:
There's 0% chance this won't be one of the best fried chickens you've had.  It's crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, perfectly seasoned. I'll show you how you can make it at home! 


FOLLOW ME
☞IG: https://www.instagram.com/laurence_louie/
☞FB: https://www.facebook.com/cheflaurencelouie/

INGREDIENTS

Marinade 
1kg Chicken Thigh (2lbs or 6x Chicken thighs)
1 Egg White
2 TBSP Soy
2 TBSP Chinese Cooking Wine
2 Garlic crushed
1 tsp Salt
1 tsp 5 spice
3 TBSP cornstarch 

Dusting
1 Cup Coarse Sweet Potato Starch

Pepper/Salt Seasoning 
1/2 tsp Salt
1/8 tsp White Pepper
1/8 tsp Sichuan PepperCorn

Garnish
1x Bunch Thai Basil

1:15 - Marinade

2:08 - Dusting Chicken
